# `list`

Helper: `list(items, { box, plain, ordered, sq })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaTile` (core:ui), `PemaCareRow` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Rows with optional number, icon or avatar on the left, text (optional over line, title 600, sub lines) and actions or a chevron on the right.

## Variants

- Plain divided rows (default)
- `box`: bordered rows
- `plain`: text lines (guide steps)
- `ordered`: numbered
- `sq` + `chev`: Patient Mobile document row

## States

- Static on the canvas; a clickable row is a link in the kit

## Tokens

line, brand-50, brand-500, brand-700, ink, ink-soft, surface, radius-tile (box, sq)

## Do

- Use for 1-6 simple rows or when a table has one useful column
- Put money or a status in `actions`

## Don't

- Do not use for 3+ rows that need several comparable columns (table)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Row padding 10/0 (box rows 12/14).

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Rows `{ t, sub, sub2, over, icon, avatar, chev, actions }`; `ordered` numbers them, `plain` = text lines (guide steps), `box` = bordered rows (wait cards, the journey photo shortcut). `sq` + `chev` = the Patient Mobile doc-row: rounded-square icon tile and a trailing "›"; money or a status goes in `actions`
